collection_method: Claude Code WebSearch tool (Brave Search-backed), live interactive query, one query per prompt, first-page results only
engine_caveat: This is Claude's own grounded web search (a general web index), not a direct query to ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot or Perplexity. No free API access exists to those engines, so this audit does not claim to represent them. See methodology.
generation_note: 40 prompts generated by combining each of the 13 distinct subjects from prompts/prompt_bank.json core_15 with one weekly_variant_axes value each (sector, service, location, buyer_role, buying_stage, problem, or outcome; never more than 2 axes stacked), phrased as natural buyer questions, per the generation_note in prompt_bank.json. Third ISO-week run recorded in the repo (prior runs 2026-09-21, 2026-09-28); combos were freshly chosen this week rather than repeated verbatim.
